title: विश्वासको मत लिँदै मुख्यमन्त्री कृष्ण यादव, सरकार अझै अनिश्चित
content:
No ads found for this position जनकपुरधाम । मधेश प्रदेशका मुख्यमन्त्री कृष्णप्रसाद यादवले आज (शनिबार) प्रदेश सभाबाट विश्वासको मत लिँदैछन् । तर, आवश्यक बहुमत जुटाउन नसक्दा उनको सरकारको भविष्य अझै अनिश्चित बनेको छ । एक महिनादेखि अल्पमतको सरकार सञ्चालन गरिरहेका मुख्यमन्त्री यादवले आज दिउँसो १ बजे बस्ने प्रदेश सभा बैठकमा विश्वासको मत लिने तयारी गरेका छन् । १ सय ७ सदस्यीय मधेश प्रदेश सभामा विश्वासको मत प्राप्त गर्न कम्तीमा ५४ सांसदको समर्थन आवश्यक पर्छ । तर, हाल कायम १ सय ३ सांसदमध्ये मुख्यमन्त्री यादवको दल नेपाली कांग्रेसका २२ सांसद मात्रै छन् । एमाले र नेकपाले सरकारलाई दिएको समर्थन फिर्ता लिएपछि यादव अल्पमतमा परेका हुन् । विश्वासको मत पाउन नसके मुख्यमन्त्री यादव आजै पदमुक्त हुनेछन् । त्यसपछि मधेशमा नयाँ सरकार गठनको प्रक्रिया अघि बढ्नेछ । मधेश प्रदेश सभामा २८ सिटसहित जनता समाजवादी पार्टी (जसपा) सबैभन्दा ठूलो दल छ । जसपाले नयाँ सरकारको नेतृत्व गर्ने रणनीति बनाइरहेको छ । त्यस्तै, एमालेका २४, नेपाली कांग्रेसका २२, नेकपाका १४ र जनमत पार्टीका १२ सांसद छन् । नेपाल संघीय समाजवादी पार्टी, राष्ट्रिय प्रजातन्त्र पार्टी र नागरिक उन्मुक्ति पार्टीका एक–एक सांसद छन् । विश्वासको मत लिने प्रयोजनका लागि शनिबार दिउँसो १ बजे प्रदेश सभा बैठक बोलाइएको छ । Janakpurdham. Madhesh Province Chief Minister Krishna Prasad Yadav is seeking a vote of confidence from the provincial assembly today (Saturday). However, the future of his government remains uncertain as he has not been able to secure the required majority. Chief Minister Yadav, who has been running a minority government for a month, is preparing to seek a vote of confidence in the provincial assembly meeting to be held at 11 am today. The 107-member Madhesh Provincial Assembly requires the support of at least 54 MPs to secure a vote of confidence. However, out of the current 103 MPs, Chief Minister Yadav's party, Nepali Congress, has only 22 MPs. Yadav is in a minority after the UML and the NCP withdrew their support to the government. Chief Minister Yadav will resign from his post today if he fails to get a vote of confidence. After that, the process of forming a new government in Madhesh will move forward. The Janata Samajwadi Party (JSP) is the largest party in the Madhesh Provincial Assembly with 28 seats. The JSP is formulating a strategy to lead the new government. Similarly, the UML has 24, the Nepali Congress 22, the NCP 14 and the Janmat Party 12 MPs. The Nepal Federal Socialist Party, the Rastriya Prajatantra Party and the Nagarik Unmukti Party have one MP each. A provincial assembly meeting has been called for Saturday at 11 am for the purpose of taking a vote of confidence.

Janakpurdham. Madhesh Province Chief Minister Krishna Prasad Yadav is seeking a vote of confidence from the provincial assembly today (Saturday). However, the future of his government remains uncertain as he has not been able to secure the required majority. Chief Minister Yadav, who has been running a minority government for a month, is preparing to seek a vote of confidence in the provincial assembly meeting to be held at 11 am today. The Nepal Federal Socialist Party, the Rastriya Prajatantra Party and the Nagarik Unmukti Party have one MP each.
